name: hcapp_getEventMessages
description: Returns all messages for a specific event. Token validated against DeviceSecret + eventId (event-bound token). Author data is embedded as a nested JSON object using FOR JSON PATH. Use hcapp_getEventMessages2 for a flat author representation.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID for auth lookup. DATALENGTH check (always 16 for non-null UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) provides no real validation.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Token validated against DeviceSecret + eventId — event-bound.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal event ID (not PublicEventId). DATALENGTH check validates 16 bytes = valid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

rowsets.name: NullDeviceIdError
rowsets.description: emitted but SP does NOT RETURN. errorType=2.

rowsets.name: NullEventIdError
rowsets.description: Emitted but SP does NOT RETURN. errorType=2.

rowsets.name: NullHasherError
rowsets.description: Returned when Device lookup yields no userId (only if prior errors were not triggered). errorType=2.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned on token failure. SP RETURNS after this. errorType=3.

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: All messages for the event, ordered by createdAt DESC.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (DATEDIFF_BIG from epoch).

columns.name: author
columns.description: JSON object: {id: PublicHasherId, firstName: DisplayName, imageUrl: Photo}. Embedded via FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER.

codeSmells.issue: Multiple error paths emit rowsets without RETURN — caller may receive multiple error rowsets
codeSmells.detail: deviceId null check and eventId null check both emit SELECT without RETURN. Only auth failure and the final @isError check cause RETURN.

codeSmells.issue: Author nested as JSON string via FOR JSON PATH — not a typed column
codeSmells.detail: The 'author' column returns a JSON string, not a structured column. Callers must parse this JSON themselves. This is an unusual pattern — hcapp_getEventMessages2 returns a flat authorId instead.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the JSON structure of the author field without updating all callers
